findings: S2: 01-PRD.md lists nine must-have features. QC_spec S2 asks for 3 to 6; generate_instruction.md PHASE 1 raises that band to 6 to 10 when a companion document is supplied, which it is here (immersiveg_prd.md). The companion band governs, and the disagreement is recorded rather than silently passed.

S5: 04-uiux-brief.md carries no hex palette, no pixel type scale and no millisecond motion values. QC_spec S5 predates the settled number rule (generate_instruction.md section 4, 'The number rule, DECIDED'), which forbids exactly those and is enforced on the brief by source_lint's hex sweep. The doc carries colour as the five neutral roles, opacity as nine named levels, motion as three curve families and seven named curves, the three font families by name, and the accessibility bars as WCAG AA contrast, comfortable touch targets and visible focus.

A1: the brief carries ten of the eleven H2s QC_instruction A1 lists and adds '## Front-end specification'. '## Build plan' is absent by design: generate_instruction.md section 2.1 removed it from the baseline emission, and '## Front-end specification' is the unbudgeted home that same prompt names for a long visual specification. window_lint (G33) reads six sections and finds all six.

A8: the brief names DB_URL alongside DATABASE_URL. A8 grades DB_URL as off-canon MINOR. reference/C C.2 requires both names to be injected with the same value precisely so a brief that says DATABASE_URL reaches a live datastore, so the pair is deliberate.
B3: two of the three levers are present. The third, '## Build plan', is not baseline; see A1.

C1: every rule that governs a refusal carries its negative case and its rejection outcome. Several numbered lines in '## Core features' state seeded facts rather than rules (the eighteen-project table, the seeded descriptions, the chapter numerals) and carry no negative, because there is no action to refuse.

C5: '## Data model' states each concurrency invariant as an observable rule and names no index, lock or isolation level. C5 asks for the storage-level construct; INV9 and prescription_lint (G43) forbid it in that section, and G43 is the later rule. The invariants themselves are all stated: the unique content hash, the unique normalised address, the reel section constraint, the retired path primary key, the at-most-one live scene configuration and the record version.

C7: every one of the six judged sections runs past its reference length, and the joined six run past the 9000-char slice. window_lint (G33) reports length and fails nothing, and generate_instruction.md section 4 says not to cut a rule to fit. What the judge will not read is the tail of '## Core features' from 'The media pipeline' onward, and all of '## User roles' and '## Overview'. Every rule that tail carries is graded by the pytest layer or by a workflow substep rather than by the judge.

RC-12: R7 grades subtitle text rendering by default in the backstage overlay, and the pytest layer separately asserts that a reel section carrying audio and carrying no subtitle cannot be stored. The two are separable in both directions. A build whose schema refuses the row yet whose overlay hides the cues behind a captions control fails R7 while the test passes; a build that renders cues it accepted through a permissive schema fails the test while R7 passes. Recorded here because INV7 requires both runs to be written down before either grader ships.

BENCH-003: turns_expected 160 and tokens_expected 5500000 sit in the medium band this row documents, but difficulty is the empty placeholder BENCH-006 requires, so the band cannot be checked against a declared difficulty. The pair is recorded against the medium row and calibration will confirm or move it.

BENCH-005: the complexity signals, two service slots, two console roles plus an anonymous visitor, ten of eleven spec sections given, and the Standard resource tier, are consistent with the medium band the budget was drawn from. difficulty itself is empty by BENCH-006, so this row is judged against the signals rather than against a declared value.

COV-004: 06-implementation-plan.md is authoring-side only. '## Build plan' is not emitted at baseline (generate_instruction.md section 2.1), so the document reaches no field in task.toml. Its exclusion is recorded here and in 00-decisions.md rather than left to be discovered.

CMP-013: environment/docker-compose.yaml mounts ./postgres-init.sql read only into the datastore's init directory, and the minio-init service creates the private bucket once before parking. Both are INFRA bootstrap, which stage-5-dockerfile.md allows explicitly: the first creates the unprivileged deku_app role and the second creates the bucket the app is handed by STORAGE_BUCKET. No application row and no media object is seeded there; the app seeds its own content on first start, which the pytest layer asserts.
